stopping_rules: If the Phase0 canonical result fails SHA/CRC/manifest/decision validation, HOLD before freezing any contract.
If any B01-B08 closure lock differs from Phase0, HOLD; do not normalize labels.
If any required link class, missingness class, branch role or edge rule is absent after serialization, HOLD.
If the contract bundle hash differs from the starter-frozen hash, HOLD.
Phase1 performs no Master reopening, nested-ZIP access, event joins, scientific numerical computation or relationship assignment.

reopen_rules.condition: New public selection/injection assets become available
reopen_rules.action: New separately preregistered extension; do not alter historical NO-GO.

reopen_rules.condition: Remnant/ringdown primary schema becomes unambiguously resolvable
reopen_rules.action: New separately preregistered extension; preserve historical HOLD.

reopen_rules.condition: Independent release provides compatible replication schema/samples
reopen_rules.action: New replication run; historical no-test closure remains provenance.
New preregistration before conversion; Phase5 post-hoc diagnostic remains post-hoc.

reopen_rules.condition: Numerical propagation across any structural edge desired
reopen_rules.action: Create a dedicated end-to-end propagation preregistration with exact common-frame inputs.
